articles.title: No GHADC polls till April: Meghalaya Cabinet approves second 6-month extension
articles.summary: SHILLONG, OCT 7: Garo Hills will have to wait longer for autonomous council polls. The Meghalaya cabinet on Wednesday cleared another six-month extension for the Garo Hills Autonomous District Council (GHADC), pushing elections to early next year. The first six-month extension ends on October 17.
